steps.text: Welcome, {name}. Every action uses up years of a short life: a hunt takes 2. Begin with a Hunt for XP, gold and loot.
{name} is badly hurt. Rest heals fully for 1 year; a potion heals at once, for gold.
Train a stat for a lasting bonus: STR hits harder, MAG casts stronger, AGI is quicker, VIT is tougher. Takes 2 years.
{name} can found a family now. Children inherit traits and carry the house on when {name} is gone.
A family needs age {min_age}. Until then, hunt, train and earn gold. Children carry the house on.
The house is founded. Hunt on, then Retire to hand it to a child. If {name} dies first, a child inherits anyway.
{dead} has passed. Pick the child who carries the house on. A lower Fate Value means fewer random failures.
